title: Turning GLM-5.3-Flash into a Jev-like decision model
summary: A technical approach to transform standard LLMs like GLM-5.3-Flash into fast decision-making models by crafting prompts that force single-token first output, enabling one-shot decisions without specialized architectures.
problem_solved: Enabling standard LLMs to make rapid, single-token decisions comparable to specialized decision models like Jev
why_valuable: Reduces inference cost and complexity by achieving specialized model performance using general-purpose LLMs with optimized prompts
